en.text:
Hits against <link Minor Combatants [#CombatantClassifications] /> grant 2 Stacks of Redirection. Maximum of 30 Stacks.

Stacks remain active while stowed.

Hits against <link Elite or higher-ranked Combatants [#CombatantClassifications] /> consume up to #e${3-#d} Stacks to grant #e${33+#f}% increased damage per Stack consumed.

enhanced (
var d = 1
var f = 17
#e Maximum number of Stacks consumed per shot is decreased by 1. Damage increase granted by each Stack is increased to 50% (from 33%).
)
